title: Download Dubbed Audio Tracks from YouTube — Hindi, Spanish, Japanese & More
description: Learn how to download dubbed audio tracks from YouTube videos. Extract Hindi, Spanish, French, Japanese, and 157+ other dubbed languages as MP3 or M4A — free.
content:
What Are YouTube Dubbed Audio Tracks?

In 2023, YouTube introduced multi-language audio tracks, allowing creators to upload dubbed versions of their videos. Viewers can switch between languages using the gear icon (Settings → Audio track). This feature is especially popular on movie trailers, documentaries, and educational channels.

How to Find Videos with Dubbed Audio

Not all YouTube videos have dubbed audio. Videos that do typically show a language selector in the settings menu. Major movie studios (Marvel, Sony, Warner Bros), educational channels (Kurzgesagt, TED), and international creators are the most common users of multi-language audio.

Step-by-Step: Download Dubbed Audio

Step 1: Copy the YouTube URL

Find a video with dubbed audio tracks (try a popular movie trailer). Copy the URL from YouTube.

Step 2: Paste into AudioTrackDown

Go to AudioTrackDown and paste the URL. Click Extract. The tool scans the video using multiple YouTube player clients to detect all available audio tracks.

Step 3: Select Your Language

If dubbed tracks are available, you'll see cards for each language with a flag emoji and language name:

  • 🇺🇸 English (Original)
  • 🇮🇳 Hindi
  • 🇪🇸 Spanish
  • 🇯🇵 Japanese
  • 🇫🇷 French
  • 🇩🇪 German
  • 🇧🇷 Portuguese
  • 🇰🇷 Korean
  • 🇸🇦 Arabic
  • 🇷🇺 Russian
  • ...and 147+ more

Step 4: Choose Format and Download

Each language card offers MP3, M4A, and WebM download options. Click Download next to your preferred format, and the dubbed audio file will be saved to your device.

Popular Use Cases for Dubbed Audio

  • Language learning — Listen to content in your target language
  • Accessibility — Understand content in your native language
  • Content creation — Use dubbed audio for reaction videos or remixes
  • Offline listening — Save dubbed podcasts or lectures for travel
  • Research — Compare original and dubbed dialogue for translation studies

Frequently Asked Questions

Why don't I see dubbed tracks for some videos?

The video creator hasn't uploaded dubbed audio tracks. Not all videos support multi-language audio — it's an optional feature that creators must enable.

Is the audio quality the same as the original?

Yes — dubbed audio tracks are typically encoded at the same bitrate as the original. M4A at 256kbps offers the highest quality, while MP3 at 192kbps provides universal compatibility.
